611:t_008:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't be ridiculous! $$次元力$$ controlling events is just theory!」

611:t_008:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「It burns me up to admit it, but the $$サイデリアル$$ are way ahead of us at using $$スフィア$$!」

611:t_008:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So we've got no choice but to fight with this handicap on our backs...!」

611:t_008:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If we retreat carelessly, we'll just get shot in the back!」

611:t_008:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To break the deadlock, concentrate the attack on the three adjutants!」

611:t_008:14.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Fighting those three in this state...」

611:t_008:15.en:
$$シン$$
「But if we can't beat them, there's no way we can beat the $$サイデリアル$$' reactor!」

611:t_008:21.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah! If it's come to this, we just keep pushing forward until we run out of strength!!」

611:t_008:22.en:
$n
(So this is $$次元力$$... This is the power of the $$スフィア$$...)

611:t_008:23.en:
$n
(Is that... the power of a god...?)

611:t_009:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you all keep making such a miserable spectacle of yourselves, people all over the world will be disappointed.」

611:t_009:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Gah! Pinch or no pinch, that's the nickname I hate most!」

611:t_009:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you're so mad, come at us head-on!」

611:t_009:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「No thanks. I... have a policy of winning the easy way if I can.」

611:t_009:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So with that said, let's go in for the finishing blow.」

611:t_010:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Uh-oh! What he's after is...!」

611:t_010:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Our target is the enemy mothership! Let's settle this in one stroke!」

611:t_014:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルゴラ$$ Unit 1 and Unit 2!」

611:t_014:1.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Looks like we made our entrance at just the right time.」

611:t_014:2.en:
$$トビー$$
「Been doing all right, $$セツコ$$?!」

611:t_015:0.en:
$$渓$$
「Uh-oh! They got around to our flank!」

611:t_016:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$パールネイル$$...! Is that $$マルグリット$$?!」

611:t_016:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「And is that $$カオス・カペル$$ over there?!」

611:t_016:3.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I'm not a member of 《$$カイメラ$$》 anymore. This unit's name is $$エリファス$$.」

611:t_016:4.en:
$$桂$$
「I've been waiting for you, $$ツィーネ・エスピオ$$.」

611:t_016:5.en:
$$桂$$
「Or should I call you $$クィーン$$?」

611:t_016:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That woman is $$クロノ$$'s $$クィーン$$?!」

611:t_016:7.en:
$$メール$$
「That boob monster from $$カイメラ$$?!」

611:t_016:8.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「So you really had noticed, $$桂木桂$$.」

611:t_016:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To think they would come as our reinforcements.」

611:t_016:14.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Don't think four units can turn this situation around!」

611:t_016:15.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「What a shame... The one who matters is someone else.」

611:t_017:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But as a $$ハイアデス$$ member, I can tell! That ship's combat power is nothing much!」

611:t_017:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'd rather you not judge this $$ソーラリアン$$'s worth by simple attack power.」

611:t_017:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「Causality distortion convergence point, confirmed! We're reversing the phase there and normalizing it!」

611:t_018:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The distortion in causality is being repaired...!」

611:t_018:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「That was supposed to be your big trump-card plan. Too bad for you.」

611:t_018:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「This $$ソーラリアン$$ is itself the system that controls events.」

611:t_018:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right, $$桂$$. This is what I've been researching all this time with your help.」

611:t_018:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You really pulled it off, Chief!」

611:t_018:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「No, it's not my achievement. This is the crystallization of the wisdom of Earth's scientists.」

611:t_018:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「The members of the $$科学要塞研究所$$ led by Dr. $$弓$$, Dr. $$敷島$$, $$里香$$-chan of $$２１世紀警備保障$$, $$プリン伯爵$$, $$セシル$$, $$ラクシャータ$$, $$ビリー$$...」

611:t_018:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$梅本$$, who just happened to be passing by, and the $$ウィスパード$$ girl, the technical staff of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$...」

611:t_018:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「This $$ソーラリアン$$ was completed with the wisdom borrowed from all those other people, too.」

611:t_018:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But how do you control events?!」

611:t_018:12.en:
$n
「Is it the power of a pseudo-$$スフィア$$?!」

611:t_018:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For today of all days, don't we have something that has been gathering people's feelings ever since the $$時獄戦役$$?」

611:t_018:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right! It's the power of the $$Ｚクリスタル$$!」

611:t_019:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「As expected of the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ that gathered $c's feelings. It seems to have shown more power than just repairing causality.」

611:t_020:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「It's like the way my body felt a moment ago was a lie...」

カオス・カペル.evidence: Ziene's unit (Rand names it 611:t_016:2); not in sheet. Katakana transliteration.

エリファス.evidence: Ziene says her unit is now named エリファス (611:t_016:3); not in sheet. Likely from Eliphas Levi (occultist), romanized 'Elifas'.

プリン伯爵.evidence: Named in Traia's list of Earth scientists who helped build the Solarian (611:t_018:8); no sheet entry. Precedent: ブロッケン伯爵 = Count Brocken.

uncertain: 611:t_018:8/9: プリン伯爵 has no sheet entry (proposed 'Count Purin'); 弓博士/敷島博士 rendered 'Dr. $$弓$$' / 'Dr. $$敷島$$' using surname tokens; ウィスパードちゃん = 'the Whispered girl' (referent unknown, gender from ちゃん only); 通りすがりの梅本さん = '$$梅本$$, who just happened to be passing by'.
611:t_016:2/3: カオス・カペル ('Chaos Kapel') and エリファス ('Elifas') are not in the sheet; romanizations proposed.
611:t_010:1: Teitania's 奴 taken as Dabalan (he states the target two rows later), rendered 'he'.
611:t_009:1/2: サルのおっさん = 'Monkey Geezer' (Sardias -> サル pun, sheet has no precedent); 611:t_008:17 Gai's とは言うけどよ = 'Easier said than done!'; 611:t_008:13 副官 = 'adjutants' (earlier slice precedent).
611:t_016:15: 本命 rendered 'The one who matters' (the real target/main force).
